protocol.featureMeaning: Fictional binary process facts assigned and available at opening; no real effect, person, employer or intervention claim.
protocol.predictionTime: Fit and freeze the model at origin. Predict each test cohort at its own opening timestamp using then-available features. November/December features are not claimed known on October1. No test labels update the frozen model.
protocol.negative: No actual start within 90 days; simulated cancellations and unresolved searches with full follow-up
protocol.baselineSmoothing: Add one start and one non-start, both globally and per feature cell. Unseen cells fall back to pooled rate.
protocol.generator: Eight binary feature cells each month. Normally 40 openings per cell. In mix-shift assessment only, count is 10+10*popcount(mask). Planted logit=-0.2+0.7*(2*definedScope-1)+0.7*(2*panelReserved-1)+0.7*(2*flexibleStartWindow-1). In relationship-reversal assessment only, negate all three slopes; intercept unchanged. Deterministic hash-based Bernoulli draws. Negatives split into floor(0.3*negative) cancelled and remaining unresolved. No changes to the company dataset.
protocol.development: Use the four named development histories for implementation and method checks only. No hyperparameter, feature, threshold or seed selection. Freeze generator and evaluator code before assessment. Do not optimize to assessment results.
protocol.assessment: All training labels released by origin; all test feature rows and predictions fixed before any assessment outcome retrieval. Report every family, seed and method. Report calibration bins, Brier, log loss, confusion cells and undefined metrics. Aggregate counts are not independent person-level observations.
protocol.educationalGate: In BOTH stable and mix-shift assessment, logistic balanced accuracy >=0.60, Brier at least0.02 lower than pooled, and Brier no more than0.005 above cell-rate. Every family and method must retain complete accounting, finite scores and all stress results. Reversal need not pass performance thresholds and must be displayed as failure if it fails. This gate supports a teaching example only, never operational qualification or model superiority over the cell baseline.
protocol.presentation: Only integrate if the educational gate and engineering tests pass. Probability/comparison view by default; confusion matrices only on explicit request. Preserve old saved experiment answers and source versions. Clearly show planted features, historical test dates, all stress cases and no real-world accuracy/causal claim.
protocol.limits: Known mechanism synthetic holdout with independent seeds and later temporal cohorts, not blind mechanisms or real outcomes. No spending, source refresh, personal scoring, company forecast or automatic plan mutation. No confidence intervals or statistical-significance claim. Any changed design after assessment needs another version and fresh holdout.
